current.title: Round 69 DELIVERED — the computer-use enforcement layer (0.69.0)
current.detail: R68 built the mechanisms (SendInput, the self-healing foreground, the poked Chromium tree, 30s frames, the capture-excluded monitor); R69 makes verification AUTOMATIC: every mutating action returns an observation receipt (fresh frame + screenChanged + focusedElementName + activeApp title after a 600ms settle; returnState compact default/none/full), coordinate clicks verify changed/unchanged + name the hit element, stale frames auto-refresh perceptually (frame_changed carries the already-registered fresh frame — the frame_stale dead-end dies for pointer tools), and the 3rd near-identical capture refuses screen_unchanged with act/wait()/find_elements guidance. Windows fixes: the quadratic over-scroll eliminated (one wheel event, HWHEEL horizontal), long type >300 chars rides a stdin clipboard paste (ARGV ceiling bypassed), the dual-object Chromium poke + sparse-poll + --force-renderer-accessibility launches. The mini monitor never steals focus (WS_EX_NOACTIVATE; tao's set_focus ALT-key synthesis removed). Prompts + the skill re-taught the receipt-driven loop; pngjs@7 (MIT) joins a CLEAN 134-dep audit. Verification: 2082/2082 tests in 123 files, e2e 12/12, lint/typecheck clean, build green, cargo check (Windows target) clean. The owner's next live Windows run is the gate (all Windows behavior construction-pinned).
